method: BTO projects within about 1 km (straight line, nearest block), found by grouping HDB blocks by their OneMap building name. Completed projects use HDB unit counts; under-construction projects use BTOHQ (unverified). Earliest resale is completion plus the minimum occupation period (5 years; 10 for Plus and Prime) and is an estimate.
